svg.title: JobScrape hexagonal architecture: cockpit, adapters, application core
svg.text: Bun BFF serves UI · HTTPS loopback
Interface: DTOs in, Problem Details out. No mediator.
Infrastructure: EF stores · Dapper · Playwright · files.
Ports live in the core. Adapters implement them.
Vertical slices: Runs · Scraping · Profiles · Sources · Sessions.
